first_impression: The page title identifies Gigr as a trusted local services marketplace, but the visible app remained on a Loading… state.
action_attempted: Waited for the marketplace dashboard to load and inspected the interactive page.
after_state: The page still displayed only Loading… after several seconds; no hiring or service-search controls became available.
notes: Live page was reachable, but the central workflow could not be exercised because loading did not complete.

first_impression: A text-first English navigation interface presents a place search, voice search, Directions and Nearby controls, with location currently unavailable.
action_attempted: Entered “Seoul Station” in the place search and clicked Search.
after_state: The app displayed 21 places with category filters and accessible button descriptions containing names, categories, and addresses.
notes: The no-map, plain-text search workflow worked and returned structured place results.

first_impression: Givens opens to a Sudoku studio with puzzle presets, a fully labeled grid, number controls, and explicit hint/apply/lock actions.
action_attempted: Clicked Apply next step on the Last five puzzle.
after_state: The page remained on the same puzzle and the grid values appeared unchanged; no obvious confirmation or applied next step was exposed in the accessible state.
notes: The shared grid and agent-oriented controls were present, but this direct apply action showed no observable state change.

first_impression: A Portuguese URL shortener form asks for a URL and desired alias, with a single Encurtar action.
action_attempted: Entered https://example.com with alias obs038 and clicked Encurtar.
after_state: A Copiar button appeared above the form, indicating a shortened-link result was created and can be copied.
notes: The core create-short-link flow worked without login.

first_impression: The landing page presents Human × AI Go, a match hall, queue/invite actions, and a disabled waiting-room board preview.
after_state: The board preview remained visible with labeled disabled grid cells and preset stones; no playable match or state transition occurred.
notes: The human-versus-AI concept and preview are clear, but the central play workflow requires joining a queue or inviting an AI.

first_impression: A 3D Studio workbench shows a Chinese Checkers scene hierarchy, viewport, inspector fields, and agent collaboration receipts/statuses.
action_attempted: Selected the Board object in the scene hierarchy.
after_state: The workbench stayed coherent with the hierarchy selection interaction available and inspector/tooling panels present; no destructive change was made.
notes: The app visibly supports staged scene inspection/editing with an explicit Apply-style workflow and agent activity panel.
